text: I found the cause. The app's update check asks GitHub for the repo's latest Release. Since the daily data-archive Releases (propline-archive and similar, which carry no APK) started, that call returns one of those instead of the app. The app then sees no APK and never shows an update. It's a bug in my code, not a setting on your phone. I've queued the fix: look through the recent Releases for the newest v-numbered one with an APK. It needs a new build, so the next session that holds the repo lease will ship it. You'll need to install that build by hand from the Releases page (v0.114.17 or newer), and updates after that will notify you.
